beats.say: You can now lock your private ChatGPT conversations behind a PIN.
OpenAI introduced this locked chats feature to help users secure sensitive data.
According to Engadget, it is available for Free, Go, Plus, and Pro subscriptions.
Users can authenticate using a PIN or their own biometric data.
However, these chats are not protected by end to end encryption.
TechCrunch warns that resetting your account PIN will delete all locked chats.
Will you use a PIN to hide your conversations?
